associates.clause:
A person closely associated with a PDMR, being: 
(a) a family member (meaning a spouse, civil partner, or dependent children 
or stepchildren of the PDMR or a relative who has shared the same 
household as the PDMR for at least one year on the date of Dealing) or 
(b) a company, trust, partnership or entity:
associates.reasoning: The Policy defines Persons Closely Associated with a PDMR to include family members and controlled companies, trusts or partnerships, and imposes Closed Period and notification obligations on PDMRs in respect of their PCAs' dealings.

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause:
entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is 
dependent upon the price of a Rio Tinto Security, including but 
not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the 
economic risk of holding a Rio Tinto Security;
findings.definition:
entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is 
dependent upon the price of a Rio Tinto Security, including but 
not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the

findings.reasoning: A hedge is swept into Dealing by definition (e), but Rio Tinto Personnel who are not Restricted Persons or PDMRs are subject only to the Insider Dealing prohibition, with no clearance requirement or approval step for this tier.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause:
entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is

not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the

findings.definition:
entering into a transaction the economic outcome of which is

not limited to a transaction which has the effect of limiting the 
economic risk of holding a Rio Tinto Security;
findings.reasoning: The definition does not distinguish settlement method, so a physically settled hedge is likewise unrestricted for this tier beyond the Insider Dealing prohibition.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause:
entering into any margin lending, derivative contract or other 
secured financial arrangement pursuant to which a charge is 
granted over the Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.definition:
entering into any margin lending, derivative contract or other 
secured financial arrangement pursuant to which a charge is 
granted over the Rio Tinto Securities.
findings.reasoning: Margin lending is swept into Dealing by definition (h), but this tier faces no clearance requirement, only the general Insider Dealing prohibition.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.reasoning: Definition (h) addresses financial arrangements secured by a charge over Rio Tinto Securities themselves, not a loan secured on a derivative over them, and no other clause addresses it for this tier.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.reasoning: No clause or definition item clearly addresses lending Rio Tinto Securities under a title-transfer securities loan for this tier.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: a disposal of Rio Tinto Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
findings.reasoning: A disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights is expressly excluded from the operation of the Policy, subject only to the Insider Dealing prohibition.

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause:
PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following 
Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto 
Securities: 
(a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.reasoning: PDMRs are expressly prohibited from dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities, which covers a cash-settled hedge such as a collar or put.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause:
PDMRs are prohibited from undertaking any of the following 
Dealings with respect to Rio Tinto 
Securities: 
(a) Dealing in derivative products issued over or in respect of Rio Tinto Securities;
findings.reasoning: The prohibition on derivative products is settlement-method neutral and so also bans a physically settled hedge.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause:
Permanent Restricted Persons and Project Restricted Persons 
are required to seek clearance 
prior to any proposed Dealing in Rio Tinto Securities, other than a Dealing excluded by section 
10.
findings.definition:
using as security, or otherwise granting a charge, lien or other 
encumbrance;
findings.reasoning: Encumbrance is swept into Dealing by definition (c); it is not listed among the specific PDMR prohibitions in 12.3, so as a Permanent Restricted Person a PDMR must obtain prior clearance before encumbering vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause:
entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto 
Securities.
findings.reasoning: PDMRs are expressly prohibited from entering into margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause:
entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto 
Securities.
findings.definition:
entering into margin lending or other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto 
Securities.
findings.reasoning: The prohibition reaches 'other secure financing arrangements in respect of Rio Tinto Securities', which is broad enough to sweep in a loan secured on a derivative over Rio Tinto Securities rather than the shares themselves.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause:
Permanent Restricted Persons and Project Restricted Persons 
are required to seek clearance 
prior to any proposed Dealing in Rio Tinto Securities, other than a Dealing excluded by section 
10.
findings.definition:
any other transaction or the exercise of any power or discretion, 
effecting a change of ownership of beneficial interest;
findings.reasoning: A title-transfer securities loan is swept into Dealing by definition (d) (a transaction effecting a change of ownership of beneficial interest); it is not excluded by section 10, so a PDMR must obtain prior clearance.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: a disposal of Rio Tinto Securities that is the result of a secured lender exercising their rights.
findings.reasoning: A disposal resulting from a secured lender exercising its rights is expressly excluded from the operation of the Policy and may be undertaken by Restricted Persons, including PDMRs, at any time without prior written clearance.
